_comment: Paper Recurrent ViT with AFFINE feedback (Γ·X+β before SA) + dual xLSTM stack (LSTM1→attention, LSTM2(H1)→heads). Same harness as RViT_plus_paper. Checkpoints OUTSIDE Drive-synced repo.

run._note_init_mode: fresh for first run; resume to continue. Do NOT warm-start from plain affine or two_lstm alone — architecture differs.

environment._note: paper 7-step task; change fixed at t=5; frozen VAE front-end

model._note: feedback=affine: memory derives scale matrix Γ + shift β, then plain self-attention on X′. two_lstm: LSTM1(H1) feeds affine block; LSTM2(H1)→H2 feeds actor/critic.

ppo._note: 150k episodes = 18,750 iters × 8. Matches the successful paper_vae_frozen / paper_2lstm runs.
